name: synthetic-fetch-not-indexed
description: SYNTHETIC live-fallback fetch for a URL treated as missing from the index. The caller omitted live and the connector sends none; the API reads an unindexed URL live by itself, so the run succeeds instead of a provider error (design D6, revised 2026-11-07).

body.title: Unindexed Example
body.content:
# Unindexed Example

Fetched live because the URL was not in the index.
